name: Altdorf (Germany)
description: Quartered black and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Altdorf (a castle on red, an eagle on blue and a tower on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Altdorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Altdorf arms — castle, eagle and tower
